notes.engine: Apple Vision is the default on macOS; PaddleOCR and Tesseract are optional alternatives.
notes.language_routing: Traditional Chinese account labels use zh-Hant; Portuguese uses an available pt-* locale; amount columns use English/digit recognition.
notes.raw_policy: Raw OCR text and source images are immutable evidence; normalized labels and amounts are stored separately.
notes.number_policy: Infer comma_dot or dot_comma from each statement's numeric evidence, not from Chinese/Portuguese language. Recovered OCR separators are sent to review.
notes.vision_preprocess: Experimental grayscale/contrast preprocessing in the Swift worker; off by default because it changes OCR text and digit separators. Benchmark against manual ground truth before enabling.
notes.vision_language_correction: labels keeps Vision language correction off the numeric debit/credit columns so amounts stay raw OCR; all/off are for A/B benchmarking only.
notes.header_fallback: auto OCRs the full PDF page header only when the embedded table image yields no bank name or statement date. It never overwrites an existing name; recovered evidence is stored as header_fallback_* fields and images/page_XXXX_header_fallback.png.
notes.amount_verifier: Experimental Tesseract digit-only second reading. Evidence columns only; it never replaces raw or parsed amounts. Default off because Tesseract read digits less reliably than Vision on issue 45.
notes.row_structure: clustered (default) or experimental projection row bands. Projection is guarded and was not an improvement on issue 45; diff row counts before using it on a new issue.
notes.amount_second_pass: ink (default) re-reads empty/unparsed/low-confidence amount cells at 3x; adopted values are flagged recovered_second_pass and reviewed. off restores single-pass OCR.
notes.label_standardization: Maps OCR labels to labels/label_lexicon.csv in a separate label_standard column; label_raw is never overwritten. Hierarchy and wrapped-label detection are included.
notes.config_file: Reference example only; the current CLI reads command-line options, not this JSON file.
